packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-05 - unverified image reading (first reader)

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overview image-001.jpg, face A)
- Not a codex leaf. Several small torn paper(?) scraps, pale buff with reddish-brown staining, mounted on a rectangular sheet of translucent grey tissue (approx. 15.5 x 7.5 cm by the scale). A modern pencil note on the tissue, lower right: "Stams StA, Fasz. 26 h"(?) (modern archival label, not part of the text).
- Above the tissue mount, two separate small oval pieces with scalloped (pinked) edges, ca. 2.5 x 1.5 cm each, faint writing visible on them.
- Script on the main scraps: brown ink, a cursive early-modern German Kurrent-type hand (looks like a document/letter or account hand, not a book hand). Short entries followed by long horizontal dash-lines ("------") filling to the right, as in a list, register or account. No columns, rubrics, initials or glosses visible.
- Main scrap (lower centre): two lines with dash fillers: "...r dahin ----" and "(?)Sund(?)zwagen(?) ..... ----". Upper scraps: "...man", "...ich(?)". Upper right scrap: numerals "36" with a following letter(s), and below "b 2"(?) - possibly numbering/foliation.
- A plastic spatula/tweezer tip lies across lower right (photographic, not part of object).
Tiles 002-004 appear to be native-resolution left/centre/right views of this face.

TILE image-002.jpg (left part of face A; overlaps image-003 on its right edge)
Lines counted top to bottom on this tile (each is a separate scrap or separate line on a scrap; vertical spacing between lines is irregular because the scraps are mounted apart):
image-002 l.1 (top scrap, right edge of tile): "Ve[...]" or "vn[...]" - one or two letters only, faint, cut by the tear
image-002 l.2: "[...]mau" / "[...]man" - final letters of a word; preceding letter partly torn ("rman"? "mann"?); minim count uncertain
image-002 l.3: "ie [...]" with a tall stroke after (perhaps "ie l" or "ie|"); beginning lost - reads as "[...]ie(?)" 
image-002 l.4 (top edge of large scrap): tops of letters only, [illegible]
image-002 l.5: "[...]er dahi[n...]" - first letter(s) a large looped form, perhaps "A" or "ff"; reading "Ar dahi" / "ffer dahi" uncertain; "dahi" clear, continues on image-003
image-002 l.6: "Vnnd zwag[...]" - large initial looping V/W (Kurrent "V"), then "nnd" (minims: "nnd" or "und"), then "zw" + "ag"/"ay" (continues on image-003). Reading "Vnnd zw..." fairly secure.
Separate long narrow scrap at far left: no visible writing, only brown stains.
Bottom of tissue: blank.

TILE image-003.jpg (centre of face A; left edge overlaps image-002 - lines repeat, not additional text)
image-003 l.1 (top scrap, = image-002 l.1): "[...]vr" / "[...]ve" - faint, letters cut; [illegible] beyond
image-003 l.2 (= image-002 l.3): single vertical stroke "l"/"|" only; rest of scrap blank
image-003 l.3 (top edge of large scrap, = image-002 l.4): letter tops only, [illegible]
image-003 l.4 (= image-002 l.5): "[...] dahin" followed by a long horizontal filler stroke "--------" ending in a comma-like hook. Full line combined with 002: "[A?/ffe?]r dahin --------". "dahin" read with Kurrent h with descender; final "n" as two minims - "dahin" fairly secure (alt. "dahier"? no - only minims after i).
image-003 l.5 (= image-002 l.6, continued): "[Vnnd] zwagen(?) traidt --------------" 
   - "zwagen": z with descender, w, then "ag" or "ay", then "e" + "n"; could also be read "zwayen" (Kurrent g/y ambiguity). Uncertain: zwagen? / zwayen?
   - "traidt": t-r-a-i-d-t, with the final d-t looped; fairly clear. (alt. "traid" + flourish)
   - Above "traidt", in the interline, a detached loop form like "G" / "Cy" / "q" - possibly an interlinear insertion or superscript sign belonging to the line above; [unclear]
   - Long filler dash to the right edge of the scrap; possibly an amount column further right lost.
Combined reading of the main line: "Vnnd zwagen(?) traidt ------"
Lower part of tissue: modern pencil "Stams' St[A ...]" (archive note).
Right edge of tile: left margin of the upper-right scrap, no writing visible on this tile.

TILE image-004.jpg (right part of face A; left edge overlaps image-003)
Upper-right scrap (separate piece; appears to be the right-hand amount column of an account/list):
image-004 l.1: "36 fl(?)" - numerals "36" then a tall looped letter group read as "fl" (gulden?) or "h"/"lb"; above it a looped ascender with a superscript stroke. To the right, faint "x"/"r" form (perhaps a kreuzer sign or second figure) - uncertain
image-004 l.2 (about 2/3 down the scrap): "[...]6(?) x(?)" or "kr(?)": a looped "b/6"-like figure with a crossbar, then a "v/x" form. Possibly amount "6 kr" - uncertain. Between l.1 and l.2 the scrap shows faint ghosted letters (show-through / offset), [illegible]
Main scrap right end (continuation of image-003 l.4-5 lines): the filler dash of the "traidt" line ends in a doubled stroke "‖"/"11" (end mark or numeral "11"?) - uncertain. Faint letter remnants above it, [illegible].
Narrow scrap far right and two small scraps lower right: brown stains/strokes only, no legible letters.
Modern pencil on tissue: "[St]ams, StA, Frg. 261n"(?) (archival label; last characters uncertain: "261n"/"26h").
Correction to survey: the pencil label reads "Frg." (not "Fasz."), "261n"(?).

Oval scalloped pieces (face A overview only; no native tile covers them): crop-01.jpg (4x upscale of overview area). Only grey smudges/faint strokes visible at overview resolution; [illegible]. A native-resolution image of these two pieces would be needed.

LAYOUT SURVEY, face B (overview image-005.jpg)
- The same tissue mount turned over (mirror arrangement of scraps: the large lower scrap now lies to the right, the "36" scrap now at upper left). Pencil label on tissue: "Stams, StA, Frg. 261v"(?) - i.e. this is the other side.
- Same reddish-brown/brown cursive hand(s). Visible: upper-left scrap "Pleuz(?)..." ; upper right narrow scraps "...Ab..." and "[..] Pfennigs(?)/Pfenning..."; large scrap with a line ending in "...4 kr(?)" with a fraction-like figure, a line "...ichgelt(?)" / "...ichgest" with a long filler and large "K"/"R" at right end; below it "...thek(?)". Small left scraps with single letters. The two oval pieces again above.
- Again list/account-like layout with filler dashes; numerals present.
Tiles 006-008 = left/centre/right at native resolution.

TILE image-006.jpg (left part of face B; overlaps image-007 on right)
Upper scrap (the reverse of the "36" scrap):
image-006 l.1: a small looped mark above the word ("m"/"w" form) - superscript or start of word, [unclear]
image-006 l.2: "Prinz." / "Brinz." / "Pluz." - large looped initial (P/B/H-type Kurrent capital), then "r/l", minims (in/u/m), then "z" with long descending loop sweeping right, followed by a point; then "C[...]" or "O[...]" at the torn right edge. Reading uncertain: "Prinz." most likely of the options, but minim count and initial unsure.
image-006 l.3: faint red-brown stroke at foot of scrap, [illegible]
Narrow scrap at far left: one curved stroke "S"/"9", [illegible]
Small scrap mid-left: "Ste[...]" / "Sth[...]" / "Ab[...]" - 3-4 letters, first a capital with loop; uncertain
Small scrap lower-left: "Th[...]" / "Fh" - capital with a loop, uncertain
Large scrap lower right (continues on image-007):
image-006 l.4 (top edge): one letter "S"/"C", rest torn
image-006 l.5: "[...]ichsgel[t]" - letters "i/r ch ß/s g e l"; read "[...]ichsgelt(?)" (continues on 007)
image-006 l.6: "1008"(?) - numerals "1 0 0 8" or "1 0 0 0"; the last figure loop could be 0 or 8; possibly a year or sum (do not over-read)
image-006 l.7: "[...] 2 [...]" - a "2"-like figure with preceding small stroke, then loops; and a bottom line of letter tops, [illegible]

TILE image-007.jpg (centre of face B; left edge overlaps image-006, right edge overlaps image-008). Plastic spatula tips at top-left and bottom.
Left edge: right part of the "Prinz(?)" scrap (= image-006 l.2), showing only the "C"/"O" at its torn edge - overlap, no new text.
Upper-right narrow scraps (continue onto image-008):
image-007 l.1: "b a tam[...]" / "6 Atom[...]" / "b Adam[...]" - small "b"/"6", then "a/A", then "tam"/"dam" with minims running off; uncertain (one candidate: "b Adam[...]")
image-007 l.2: "fl(?) Pfenni[g...]" / "R Pfenni[...]" - before the word a tall looped sign (long-s/f with loop, perhaps "fl" or "R"), then "Pfenni..." (P with looped stem, f, e, minims). "Pfenni[g]" fairly likely; continues on 008.
Large scrap:
image-007 l.3 (top of scrap, right half): row of faint/abraded letters "[...]  nÿ? ge? [...]", [illegible]
image-007 l.4: "[...] l ymß(?) ¾(?) th(?)" - a single tall stroke "l", then "ymß"/"maß" (ß/long-s ligature clear), then a stacked figure: a small "3"/"2" above a stroke, with "4"/"t" below and "h" - read as fraction "¾" + "h"/"fl"? or "¼"; very uncertain. Placement above the line l.5 suggests an interlinear addition or a separate entry.
image-007 l.5: "[...]ichsgelt" (= image-006 l.5) then a long ruled filler line running right across the scrap. Letters: "i/r", "ch"? , long s, "g", "e"/"a"?, "l"?, "t" - alternatively "[...]ißgest" / "[...]ichsgelt". Uncertain; "-gelt" (money) reading tentative. Beneath the rule, at right, a row of faint letters, [illegible].
image-007 l.6: "1008"(?) (= image-006 l.6) - "1 0 0 8"/"1 0 0 0"; overlap.
image-007 l.7: "2 Lab(?)/ 2 hel..." (= image-006 l.7) "2" then "l/h" + "eb"/"ab" - [unclear]
Pencil: "Stams, St[A...]".

TILE image-008.jpg (right part of face B; left edge overlaps image-007)
image-008 l.1 (= image-007 l.1, continued): "[...]amm[...]" / "[...]ann" - minims running to the torn edge; no more letters
image-008 l.2 (= image-007 l.2, continued): "[...]pfenningen(?)" / "[...]pfennigen" - full word on 007+008: "Pfenningen(?)" with long final flourish; second half of word: "nnig?en" - minim count uncertain ("pfennigen"/"pfenningen"). After it, faint traces "ma[...]" higher on the scrap edge, [illegible]
image-008 l.3 (= image-007 l.3): faint abraded letters "[...]f? d? r ..." [illegible]
image-008 l.4 (= image-007 l.5, end of line): the long filler rule ends with a comma-like hook, followed by "3" (Kurrent-form 3, "ε"-shaped) and a large "K"/"R" with a long diagonal slash through/after it - read as amount "3 kr(?)" (kreuzer?) or "3 R"; then a "c"/"o" at the torn edge. Below rule, faint letters [illegible].
Narrow scrap far right: no legible writing.
Pencil label on tissue: "[St]ams, StA, Frg. 261v"(?).

SUMMARY OF CONNECTED READINGS (both faces; all tentative)
Face A (pencil "...Frg. 261r"(?)):
  "[A?/ffe?]r dahin ---------"
  "Vnnd zwagen(?) traidt ---------- [‖/11?]"
  separate scrap (amount column?): "36 fl(?) [x?]" ... "[.]6(?) x/kr(?)"
  upper scraps: "[...]man(n?)", "[...]ie", "[...]vr"
Face B (pencil "...Frg. 261v"(?)):
  "Prinz.(?) C[...]"
  "b a tam[...]/b Adam[...](?)"
  "fl/R(?) Pfenningen(?)"
  "[...] l ymß/maß(?) ¾(?) h(?)"
  "[...]ichsgelt(?) ------------, 3 kr(?)"
  "1008(?)/1000"
  "2 l/heb(?)[...]"

LIMITATIONS
- Object is a set of small torn paper scraps from an early-modern German (Kurrent) document, apparently an account or list (entries with filler dashes ending in amounts). Very little continuous text survives; no span of ten lines exists on either face - the scraps hold at most 1-3 words per line. Not a book hand; no columns/rubrics.
- Scrap order and relative position are as mounted by a conservator and need not reflect original line order.
- The two scalloped oval pieces are visible only on the overviews (image-001, image-005) and are too small to read there; native images of them are needed. On face B I did not crop them.
- Kurrent g/y, minim counts, and numeral forms (0/8, 3, fraction) are uncertain throughout.
- Crops made: crop-01.jpg (oval pieces, face A overview, 4x upscale) - unreadable.
- No identification was revealed in my context; I did nothing beyond the brief's rules (read PROMPT.md, the 8 images, made one crop). I did not stop on the image limit.
